name: agents-panel
description: A live Agents pane beside the chat: each subagent's model, effort, tokens, cost, time and progress, grouped by run.

character.title: Sprite character
character.description: auto picks a character from each agent's role (explorer, planner, reviewer, tester, writer…); mixed rotates through them; or name one for every agent.

motion.title: Animate sprites
motion.description: Animate each character while its agent runs.

bodyColor.title: Sprite body colour
bodyColor.description: Hex colour of the critters' bodies, e.g. #E07F63.

animateFinished.title: Animate finished agents
animateFinished.description: Keep sprites moving after their agent finishes.
